headline: Find experts your friends actually know.
subtitle: Ask your network privately. Naura traces a warm path through 1–7 handshakes — no public post, no anonymous reviews.

contactGraph.title: Smart contact graph
contactGraph.tagline: Auto-tagged the moment you save them.
contactGraph.description: Type a sentence, drop a card, forward a message — Naura pulls out role, company, interests and adds them to the right circles.

handshake.title: Handshake search
handshake.description: "Find me a Series-A fintech CFO." Naura traces warm paths through people you actually know — and ranks them by reply odds.

telegramBot.title: Telegram bot
telegramBot.description: Forward any message. Send a voice note. It transcribes, tags, and stores it in your graph.

mcpAgents.title: MCP for AI agents
mcpAgents.tagline: "Naura, who do I know in Berlin?"
mcpAgents.description: Plug Naura into Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP-capable agent. Your graph becomes an API the agent can reason over.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Private member directories, events, ask-for-intro buttons. Naura runs the rails so organizers don't.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Naura knows the cadence each person needs — close friends weekly, ex-coworkers quarterly — and surfaces them when it makes sense.
